checks.name: legacy anonymous policy exposes synthetic essay without consent
busy-table migration times out and rolls back without changing data or grants
anon cannot directly read or mutate essays, feedback, assignments or trusted commands
authenticated cannot directly read or mutate essays, feedback, assignments or trusted commands
legacy essays retained privately; author can opt in and withdraw
submission consent, types, lengths, supported exams and identity are enforced
12 same-request independent submissions create one immutable identity; changed content conflicts
12 competing reviewers reserve exactly two slots; strangers cannot open or complete
one reviewer concurrently claiming two essays gets only one assignment
12 review retries create one receipt and count; first feedback remains in queue
simultaneous differing reviews save once and close atomically at the actual count
owner history is scoped, counts actual reviews and retains original feedback; other history stays private
only author can rate helpfulness and boolean false is preserved
failure at final counter update rolls back feedback and keeps reservation for retry
same-reviewer claim versus completion avoids the user foreign-key lock inversion
expired reservation rejects reads and writes; explicit renewal retains a valid assignment
withdrawal serializes with reads/claims and revokes all remaining reservations
supported iTEP feedback scale, required text and range are enforced
academy-scoped essays never enter public queue or reviewer access
